answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 67019 Country: India Title: Is zakah applicable on smartphones, laptops etc? Question: Does zakah applies personal equipments like Smartphone, laptop and television as now days these things are priced up to 30,000 to 50,000, which is more than the price of 6th silver. Answer ID: 67019 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1133/1212/L=11/1437) There is no zakah on these things of personal use. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
